summary.zh: 本课聚焦 PTE Academic 与 IELTS 写作中最常用的 Essay Structures，帮助中国考生掌握开头段、主体段、让步段和结尾段的高分句型。重点包括 thesis statement、topic sentence、supporting evidence、counterargument、conclusion 等学术写作结构。通过这些句型，考生可以更清楚地表达观点、组织逻辑、提升语法多样性，并减少中式英语、句子松散和逻辑连接不足等常见问题。

structure.formula: Introduction: Background statement + paraphrased topic + thesis statement. Body paragraph: Topic sentence + explanation + example/evidence + mini-conclusion. Concession paragraph: Although/While + opposing view, main argument remains stronger. Conclusion: Restated thesis + summary of key reasons + final implication.
structure.explanation: Essay Structures 指的是议论文写作中的段落组织和句型框架。在 PTE Write Essay 和 IELTS Writing Task 2 中，考生不仅要有观点，还要用清晰的 academic structure 展示观点之间的逻辑关系。高分作文通常包括明确的 introduction、连贯的 body paragraphs、必要时加入 concession 或 counterargument，并以 concise conclusion 收尾。语法上应优先使用 complex sentences、noun phrases、passive voice、relative clauses 和 formal linking expressions，避免过度依赖简单句或口语化表达。

examples.en: In recent decades, the issue of environmental protection has attracted considerable public attention.
examples.zh: 近几十年来，环境保护问题引起了公众的广泛关注。

examples.en: This essay will argue that stricter government regulations are essential for reducing industrial pollution.
examples.zh: 本文将论证，更严格的政府监管对于减少工业污染是必要的。

examples.en: One of the primary reasons for this view is that education can significantly improve an individual's employment prospects.
examples.zh: 支持这一观点的主要原因之一是，教育能够显著改善个人的就业前景。

examples.en: Although some people believe that technology may reduce face-to-face communication, its benefits in improving access to information cannot be ignored.
examples.zh: 尽管一些人认为科技可能减少面对面交流，但它在改善信息获取方面的优势不容忽视。

usage_scenarios.title: 开头段表达背景与立场
usage_scenarios.description: 在 PTE 和 IELTS 作文开头，考生需要先引出话题，再明确自己的立场。背景句应客观、概括，thesis statement 应直接说明文章主张，避免模糊表达。

examples.en: With the rapid development of digital technology, online learning has become an increasingly common part of modern education.
examples.zh: 随着数字技术的快速发展，在线学习已成为现代教育中越来越常见的一部分。

examples.en: I firmly believe that online education can complement, but not completely replace, traditional classroom learning.
examples.zh: 我坚定认为，在线教育可以补充传统课堂教学，但不能完全取代它。

usage_scenarios.title: 主体段提出核心论点
usage_scenarios.description: 主体段的第一句通常是 topic sentence，用来概括本段中心思想。PTE 写作评分重视 coherence，因此每段应只围绕一个主要观点展开。

examples.en: The most convincing argument in favour of public transport is that it can reduce traffic congestion in major cities.
examples.zh: 支持公共交通最有说服力的论点是，它能够减少大城市的交通拥堵。

examples.en: A further benefit of investing in renewable energy is its potential to create long-term economic opportunities.
examples.zh: 投资可再生能源的另一个好处是，它有可能创造长期经济机会。

usage_scenarios.title: 解释原因与扩展论证
usage_scenarios.description: 提出观点后，需要用 explanation 解释为什么这个观点成立。中国考生常常只列观点而缺少展开，因此应使用 causal structures 和 result clauses 增强逻辑。

examples.en: This is because affordable housing allows low-income families to live closer to employment centres, thereby reducing both commuting time and financial pressure.
examples.zh: 这是因为可负担住房使低收入家庭能够住得离就业中心更近，从而减少通勤时间和经济压力。

examples.en: As a result, students who receive practical training are more likely to adapt quickly to the demands of the workplace.
examples.zh: 因此，接受实践培训的学生更有可能快速适应职场需求。

usage_scenarios.title: 举例说明与提供证据
usage_scenarios.description: 在 PTE Essay 中，例子不需要像学术论文一样提供真实引用，但必须合理、具体，并服务于论点。可以使用 for example、for instance、a clear example of this is 等表达。

examples.en: For instance, many cities that have expanded their metro systems have reported a noticeable decline in private car usage.
examples.zh: 例如，许多扩建地铁系统的城市都报告称私家车使用量明显下降。

examples.en: A clear example of this can be seen in vocational education, where students acquire industry-specific skills before entering the labour market.
examples.zh: 这一点在职业教育中可以清楚看到，学生在进入劳动力市场之前获得了特定行业技能。

usage_scenarios.title: 让步与反驳不同观点
usage_scenarios.description: 高分作文并不只是单方面表达观点，还可以承认 opposing view 的合理性，再说明自己的观点更有说服力。常用结构包括 although、while、admittedly、nevertheless。

examples.en: Admittedly, private cars offer greater convenience, especially for people living in remote areas.
examples.zh: 诚然，私家车提供了更大的便利，尤其是对居住在偏远地区的人而言。

examples.en: Nevertheless, the environmental costs associated with excessive car use make public transport a more sustainable option.
examples.zh: 然而，过度使用汽车所带来的环境成本使公共交通成为更可持续的选择。

usage_scenarios.title: 结尾段总结观点
usage_scenarios.description: 结尾段应重申 thesis，而不是简单重复开头句。应总结核心理由，并给出简洁的 final implication。避免在 conclusion 中引入全新论点。

examples.en: In conclusion, while technological development may create certain social challenges, its overall contribution to education and communication is substantial.
examples.zh: 总之，尽管技术发展可能带来某些社会挑战，但它对教育和交流的整体贡献是巨大的。

examples.en: Therefore, governments and individuals should work together to ensure that technological progress benefits society as a whole.
examples.zh: 因此，政府和个人应共同努力，确保技术进步惠及整个社会。

common_mistakes.wrong: Nowadays, more and more people discuss this topic. I will talk about my opinion.
common_mistakes.correct: In recent years, this issue has become a subject of considerable public debate, and this essay will argue that government intervention is necessary.
common_mistakes.explanation: 错误句过于口语化，且“I will talk about”不符合 formal academic writing。PTE 和 IELTS 作文中应使用更正式的表达，如“this essay will argue that”或“it is necessary to consider”。

common_mistakes.wrong: Because technology is developing fast. People can study online.
common_mistakes.correct: Because technology is developing rapidly, people are now able to study online more conveniently than before.
common_mistakes.explanation: 错误句中 because 引导的从句被错误地单独成句，属于 sentence fragment。because-clause 通常需要和主句结合，形成完整的 complex sentence。

common_mistakes.wrong: There are many reasons support my opinion.
common_mistakes.correct: There are many reasons that support my opinion.
common_mistakes.explanation: 错误句缺少 relative pronoun。英语中“reasons support”不能直接连接，需使用 relative clause，如“reasons that support”或改为“The reasons for my opinion are as follows”。

common_mistakes.wrong: On the one hand, online learning is convenient. On the other hand, it saves time.
common_mistakes.correct: One major advantage of online learning is its convenience; another is that it can save students a significant amount of time.
common_mistakes.explanation: “On the one hand / on the other hand”通常用于对比相反观点，而不是列举两个同方向优点。中国考生常误用该结构，导致逻辑关系不准确。

common_mistakes.wrong: Every coin has two sides, and this topic is very important.
common_mistakes.correct: Although this issue has both advantages and disadvantages, its long-term social impact deserves careful consideration.
common_mistakes.explanation: “Every coin has two sides”属于模板化、口语化表达，在 PTE 和 IELTS 写作中显得低级且缺乏具体内容。应使用更学术的 concession structure。

common_mistakes.wrong: People should protect environment because it is good for our life.
common_mistakes.correct: People should protect the environment because it is essential for public health, biodiversity and long-term economic stability.
common_mistakes.explanation: 错误句缺少冠词“the”，且“good for our life”表达笼统。学术写作需要使用更具体的 noun phrases 来提高内容质量。

common_mistakes.wrong: In conclusion, I think this problem has many reasons, and I have explained them.
common_mistakes.correct: In conclusion, the problem is largely caused by weak regulation and limited public awareness, both of which require coordinated action from governments and communities.
common_mistakes.explanation: 错误句只描述写作过程，没有总结实质内容。结尾段应重申核心观点并概括主要论据，而不是说“我已经解释过了”。

pte_usage.description: Essay Structures 在 PTE Write Essay 中非常重要，直接影响 Content、Form、Development, Structure and Coherence、Grammar 和 General Linguistic Range 等评分维度。考生需要在有限时间内快速组织四段式或五段式文章：开头段表明立场，两个主体段展开论点，必要时加入让步或反驳，最后总结观点。清晰的结构可以帮助机器评分系统识别文章逻辑，也有助于减少语法错误和跑题风险。
sections: Reading and Writing: Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.pattern: It is widely argued that + clause.
This essay will argue that + clause.
One of the main reasons for this is that + clause.
This can be attributed to + noun phrase.
A further factor that should be considered is + noun phrase.
academic_patterns.translation: 另一个应被考虑的因素是……

academic_patterns.pattern: There is strong evidence to suggest that + clause.
Although this view may seem reasonable, it overlooks + noun phrase.
academic_patterns.translation: 尽管这一观点看似合理，但它忽视了……

academic_patterns.pattern: While + clause, it is important to recognise that + clause.
academic_patterns.translation: 虽然……，但重要的是要认识到……

academic_patterns.pattern: The consequences of this trend are likely to be significant.
academic_patterns.translation: 这一趋势的后果可能非常重大。

academic_patterns.pattern: In conclusion, it is clear that + clause.
This issue should be addressed through + noun phrase.
academic_patterns.translation: 这一问题应通过……来解决。

collocations.translation: 一个日益受到关注的问题
一个切实可行的解决方案

ai_tips: 写 PTE Essay 时，先用 30 到 60 秒确定 thesis statement，再写正文。立场明确比观点复杂更重要。
每个主体段只讨论一个核心 idea，避免在同一段中同时讨论教育、经济、环境等多个方向。
优先使用 topic sentence 开头，让评分系统和考官快速识别段落中心。
不要机械套用模板句，应根据题目关键词替换 noun phrases 和 verbs，使句子与题目高度相关。
如果时间紧张，使用四段式结构更稳妥：introduction、body paragraph 1、body paragraph 2、conclusion。
结尾段不要加入新例子或新理由，只需概括前文并重申立场。
避免连续使用短句。可以通过 because、although、which、therefore 等连接词构造 complex sentences。
在 PTE 中，语法准确性优先于炫技。不要为了使用复杂句而写出不完整或逻辑混乱的句子。

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为更正式的 Essay 开头句：Many people talk about online learning these days.
practice_questions.answer: In recent years, online learning has become a widely discussed issue in modern education.

practice_questions.question: 用“This essay will argue that”写一个关于政府应保护环境的 thesis statement。
practice_questions.answer: This essay will argue that governments should play a leading role in protecting the environment through stricter regulations and public education.

practice_questions.question: 修改错误句：Because public transport is cheap. Many people use it.
practice_questions.answer: Because public transport is affordable, many people choose to use it for daily commuting.

practice_questions.question: 用“One of the main reasons for this is that”造一个关于大学教育重要性的句子。
practice_questions.answer: One of the main reasons for this is that university education can provide students with specialised knowledge and professional skills.

practice_questions.question: 将口语化表达改为学术表达：I think cars are bad for the environment.
practice_questions.answer: It can be argued that excessive car use has a negative impact on the environment.

practice_questions.question: 用 although 写一个让步句，主题是 technology and communication。
practice_questions.answer: Although technology may reduce the frequency of face-to-face interaction, it has greatly improved communication across long distances.

practice_questions.question: 为以下 topic sentence 添加解释：Public libraries remain important in modern society.
practice_questions.answer: Public libraries remain important in modern society because they provide free access to information, learning resources and community services.

practice_questions.question: 写一个 conclusion 句，总结 renewable energy 的好处。
practice_questions.answer: In conclusion, renewable energy should be promoted because it reduces environmental damage and supports long-term economic sustainability.

practice_questions.question: 判断并修改逻辑错误：On the one hand, exercise improves health. On the other hand, it reduces stress.
practice_questions.answer: One benefit of exercise is that it improves physical health; another is that it helps reduce stress.

practice_questions.question: 用“This can be attributed to”解释城市交通拥堵的原因。
practice_questions.answer: This can be attributed to rapid urbanisation, population growth and the excessive use of private vehicles.
